title: Year-to-Date Global Semiconductor Sales Top $1 Trillion Through August
gist: SIA reports global semiconductor sales of $159.7 billion in August 2026, up 8% month over month and 144.3% year over year, with year-to-date sales passing $1 trillion for the first time. SIA projects more than $1.6 trillion for 2026.

insights.claim: Global semiconductor sales were $159.7 billion in August 2026, up 8% from July's $147.9 billion and 144.3% above August 2025's $65.4 billion (three-month moving average, WSTS data).
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Record run-rate confirms the semiconductor upcycle is still accelerating; useful as a cycle gauge for sector positioning.

insights.claim: The global semiconductor market has grown for 18 consecutive months through August.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Duration of the upcycle is long, so watch for the first sequential decline as a turning-point signal.
insights.quote: The global semiconductor market grew for the 18th consecutive month in August

insights.claim: Annual global semiconductor sales passed $1 trillion through August for the first time, and SIA projects more than $1.6 trillion for 2026.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: The $1.6T full-year projection implies sustained strength through year-end; sets the baseline for 2027 growth expectations.

insights.claim: August year-over-year sales growth by region: Americas 180.9%, Asia Pacific/All Other 143.0%, China 131.3%, Europe 98.5%, Japan 62.3%.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Americas leads, consistent with AI infrastructure buildout in US data centers; Japan and Europe lag.

insights.claim: August month-to-month sales rose in all regions: Asia Pacific/All Other 9.1%, Japan 8.5%, Americas 8.2%, Europe 7.5%, China 6.6%.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Broad-based sequential growth shows the strength is not confined to one region.
